description: This file defines a StaffService module that handles business logic related to staff entities, including methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and removing staff records.

methods.name: list()
methods.description: Returns a list of staff records; currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a staff record by ID; currently returns null.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new staff record with provided data; currently returns the input.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a staff record identified by ID with provided data; currently returns the input data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a staff record by ID; currently returns true indicating success.
